stories.headline: A longer context window is not a longer memory
stories.summary: A walk through why retrieval quality collapses well before the advertised token limit, and what that means for anyone stuffing a whole codebase into a prompt.
stories.comment: The benchmark everyone quotes measures recall of a single planted fact. Real work asks for synthesis across twenty.

stories.headline: Idempotency keys, explained without the payments jargon
stories.summary: The same idea that stops a card being charged twice stops a newsletter being mailed twice. One durable record, written before the call, read after it.
stories.comment: If your retry logic cannot answer 'did the last attempt land', it is not retry logic, it is a coin flip.

stories.headline: Reading a product's own frontend to learn its API
stories.summary: When a platform ships no public write API, its web app is still calling something. A field guide to recovering those routes responsibly, and to knowing when not to.
stories.comment: The recovery is the easy half. Deciding what happens when the route changes underneath you is the engineering.

stories.headline: Your monitoring lives inside the thing it monitors
stories.summary: A short catalogue of checks that go quiet at exactly the moment they are needed, and the one structural fix: deploy the watchdog somewhere the failure cannot reach.
stories.comment: Exit code zero is a claim about a process, not about a reader's inbox.

stories.headline: The render succeeded and the image is empty
stories.summary: Correct dimensions, a green exit code, a file on disk, and nothing visible in the middle. Why every render pipeline needs an output-side assertion.
stories.comment: Checking that the asset loaded and checking that the asset looks right are two different tests.

stories.headline: A sixth story, held back for tomorrow
stories.summary: The queue is deliberately deeper than one issue so the selector has something to choose from. This one demonstrates that only the configured number is taken.
